Topic_Name: Tell me more about your tribe.
EN: I do not know how long even he can protect us, though.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: Who or what is the Father in the Cave?
EN: Have you not heard of the god of the New Canaanites? He is our protector and our judge. He helped our ancestors find their place here in Zion.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: Who or what is the Father in the Cave?
EN: He gave us many gifts, but we are not to seek him out. His caves are forbidden to us. Those who seek them out are taken from us.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: Give me some info on this Daniel. Who is he?
EN: Daniel is a wise man, and a great friend to the Sorrows. He taught me to speak the language of New Canaan - the {maybe slightly mispronounce this}English from the holy books.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: Waking Cloud is my name. I am midwife to the Sorrows. It sounds ill-omened, no? "Midwife to sorrows."

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: Nothing else. Talk to you later.
EN: Go with fortune, friend.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: That's all I wanted to know for now.
EN: Then I will look forward to our next speaking.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: Certainly. I am happy to share my knowledge.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: About your husband... I'm afraid he was killed by White Legs during the evacuation.
EN: {Shocked, disbelieving}What? No... you must be mistaken. Daniel would have told me!

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: When we learned that Salt-Upon-Wounds had defiled Zion with his presence, Daniel ordered the children, the old, and the sick evacuated from the camp.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: My husband volunteered to lead the hunters that went with them for protection.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: I try not to worry about them, but we have had no news for so long, and Daniel seems sad when I ask him about it. Sad... and a little frightened.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: What do you do when you're not delivering babies?
EN: I tend to other hurts and sicknesses that afflict our tribe. I also scout the valley for the herbs I use in my medicines.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: Midwife? I haven't seen any children around.
EN: The children and the old have already been evacuated from the camp. They are safe enough, unless the White Legs come for us in force.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: Six years. He attended the birth of my third child. {Fond reminiscence}It was a hard birth. The River nearly carried my water to the Father, and my child's with it.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: Daniel knew the ways of New Canaan's medicine. He stepped in and saved both of our lives.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: After the birth, I asked Daniel if he would teach me what he knew of childbirth. He agreed, and so here I am.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: Yes - the language of the New Canaanites is the holy tongue, for it is the language their sacred books are written in.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: The Father in the Caves brought it to them after the Judgment, but the ancestors of the Sorrows sinned against Him. They were denied the true tongue.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: You're right. Now, what are you going to do about it?
EN: About Daniel... I don't yet know. But I am a woman of the Sorrows, and I will have restitution for my husband.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: I agree. It was arrogant and cruel - not exactly the kind of thing a friend would do.
EN: Arrogant... yes. I thought Daniel respected me, saw the Sorrows as his equals... but he manipulates us for his own ends.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: He was only doing what he thought was best for the tribe. It wasn't an easy choice for him.
EN: Perhaps... I will have to have a {emphasis}very long talk with Daniel when all of this is over. Thank you for telling me this truth.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: I'm afraid so. Daniel kept it from you because he thought the grief would distract you.
EN: How... how {emphasis}dare he? What gives him the right? I thought Daniel was my friend, but he cares nothing for the Sorrows!

Speaker: Daniel
EN: Until then.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
Topic_Name: That's all for now, but I'll be back.
EN: Yeah, reckon you will.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: I understand. I'll respect your beliefs, then, but we need to search the cave.
EN: I understand. I would prefer to leave as soon as possible, though.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: The Father in the Caves was just a man who lived a long time ago.
EN: You speak as one who has not heard the tales, who has not seen the sacred images. If you knew, you would not mock.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: Holy wrath. Right. I'll keep an eye out for that. Bet it looks a lot like a bear trap.
EN: Do not mock that which you do not know! Such talk can only anger the Father.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: I don't have time for your religious superstitions. It's just a cave, that's all.
EN: It is a holy place! If we go any deeper, we will suffer for it!

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: The Father in the Caves! The Holy Father who gave the Sorrows His succor and gave the New Canaanites His son!

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: Many of the caves around the valley are sacred to him, and those who would trespass are punished by holy wrath!

Speaker: Waking Cloud
ActorNotes: [Fearful, but more awe - this is a sacred place]
Topic_Name: < Waking Cloud talks about the Survivalist's cave >
EN: {Fearful, but more awe - this is a sacred place}We should not be here! This place... it belongs to the Father in the Caves! We must not profane it with our touch!

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: Did Daniel not give you some of the New Canaanites' fire clay? That could easily collapse a cave and trap the beasts inside.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: Look around and see if you can find a cave nearby. It may prove easier than slaying the beasts.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: We'd better get to work then.
EN: I stand with you.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: I hope that is truth, and not a boast. But I will respect your leadership.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: Fighting so many at once is a dangerous prospect, unless you are a truly mighty warrior.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: This many so close together suggests a nest nearby - if we find it and destroy it, we might have better luck.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: Let's take care of it then.
EN: As you say.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: These traps must have come from somewhere - I bet the White Legs who placed them are still around.
EN: I would suspect you are right. Perhaps we should try to find them before they lay more traps?

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: What should we do about it?
EN: Disarm the traps if you can - or find the White Legs who placed them and drive them off.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: What should we do about it?
EN: Our advance scouts should be able to deal with them if they don't have to fight off raiders at the same time.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: Okay then, let's get down there and take care of business.
EN: I will follow your command - but I advise caution if it is possible.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: So the totems are sacred to them somehow? Good to know.
EN: Yes. If their war totems were to... "disappear," they would likely lose the will to fight.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: Any advice on how to deal with the situation?
EN: You might rush them and take them by surprise. We would be badly outnumbered then, though, and these will be strong fighters.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: Any advice on how to deal with the situation?
EN: We might also use their superstition against them. White Leg warriors believe that to lose their totems on the eve of battle is a terrible omen.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: < Waking Cloud talks about the Yao Guai >
EN: Yao Guai - even our strongest hunters could not hope to kill so many. There must be a nest nearby.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: < Waking Cloud talks about the sappers / traps >
EN: This is the only sure path from the Narrows to Pine Creek! They will be cut to ribbons by these traps!

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: < Waking Cloud talks about the White Leg Camps >
EN: Those tents down there - that is a White Leg war camp. Do you see the war totems they've erected around the tents?

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: < Waking Cloud talks about the White Leg Camps >
EN: White Leg warriors pray to them for strength and savagery before battle. This is no raiding band.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: {Glad to hear it}Goot sists. We head east, then. Joshua is at our tribe's camp in the Eastern Virgin.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: You'd be surprised what "civilized" tribes will fight over.
EN: Now you sound like Joshua. He always tells me the tribal life is better, that I should stay here and forget the outside world.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: Small? Have you ever seen Hoover Dam? It's bigger than some of these mountains.
EN: Hah! {Suddenly realizing the player isn't lying}...Really? That's... my gods. Must be some mighty civilized folks who built that.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: The only recent war I know of is when Caesar's Legion attacked Hoover Dam. Is that where he fought?
EN: I don't know, he doesn't talk about it much. Maybe - but how can two civilized tribes fight over something as small as a dam?

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: Well, before he left, he didn't have those bandages all over his face. That tell you something?

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: You see his face, you'll understand.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: Typical. Just when I get a useful minion....
EN: Hey, it's not my fault! And what's this "minion" stuff? {That's it}Dahs eet - see you around, "civilized" man.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: Typical. Just when I get a useful minion....
EN: Hey, it's not my fault! And what's this "minion" stuff? {That's it}Dahs eet - see you around, "civilized" woman.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: Give my regards to Joshua, then.
EN: I will. {Goodbye my friend}Goot gonen, ahk iss.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: Are you sure? You've been a useful companion so far.
EN: Sorry - Joshua was pretty clear. Get you to Daniel, then come on home. You can take it up with him if you'd like.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: No way, pal. I'm not traipsing around the desert with a barbarian who doesn't wear pants.
EN: I don't think he'll like that answer much. You change your mind, I'll be around the Dead Horses camp. {Goodbye}Goot gonen.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: I could use a guide. Let's go.
EN: {Good}Goot! I really wasn't looking forward to talking to Joshua if you turned me down.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: I could use a guide. Let's go.
EN: Hey... as long as we're traveling together, think you could help me out with a little wildlife problem?

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: I could use a guide. Let's go.
EN: Let's move then.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: Joshua Graham - he leads our tribe. Thanks to him, the Dead Horses are strong, and safe from our enemies.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: I'm sure he will want to talk to you. You can find him just south of here, in the Angel Cave.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: Nasty bunch of raiders from up by Great Salt Lake. White Legs killed your friends at the Southern Passage.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: Not many survive White Leg raids - {slightly aside, to himself}not even by running. {Normal again}Joshua will want to hear about what happened to you.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: I had no reason to stay for that fight.
EN: But... {confused, stating something that seems blindingly obvious}they were White Legs! The enemy! You are a very strange outsider, but I think Joshua will want to speak to you anyways.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: Okay, I'll go talk to him.
EN: I won't keep you. Maybe we talk again after.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: Hang on, I want to know more about what's going on.
EN: Joshua will answer all your questions. He doesn't like being kept waiting, though - go talk to him as soon as you can.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: I'm called Follows-Chalk. Joshua sent me to scout for any outsiders coming up from the Southern Passage.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: We can talk more about that later, though - it's not smart to keep Joshua waiting.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: This is the eastern fork of the Virgin River, and it's the place we Dead Horses call home. Joshua says it is a temple to God's glory on earth.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: We can talk more about it later, though - it's not smart to keep Joshua waiting.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: < Follows Chalk greets the player at the Eastern Virgin. >
EN: Glad you made it. Joshua's just to the south, inside the Angel Cave. You'll want to talk to him straight away.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: All right, people. Been a long couple weeks, but here we are. {a big deal - Wha-la!}Zion.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: I know your feet hurt, I know you're tired. But I need everyone's mind on the trail ahead.

Speaker: Stella
EN: {anxious}Ain't the trail ahead worries me, Jed. Those descents we made, through that slot canyon back up there.

Speaker: Stella
EN: Ain't no way we're getting back out the way we come. And then what?

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {exasperated}Goddammit, Stella, heard you the first time, and the fifteenth, too

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: The New Canaanites will know a way. And if they don't, we got the maps on our friend's Pip-Boy over there.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {raising voice, giving orders}Enough lollygagging! Get moving and keep an eye out for tribals!

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: {flat}God's will.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Let him keep his dignity. Give him a fighting chance.
EN: He never had any dignity to begin with. None of them did.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Let him keep his dignity. Give him a fighting chance.
EN: But for your sake... for the Sorrows' sake, I'll let him die on his feet.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Let him keep his dignity. Give him a fighting chance.
EN: Stand up and look at what's come for you!

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Joshua, you've already won. Look around you. There's no need to kill him.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] He has a debt to pay for what he's done and I've come to collect. And so he's chosen to cower in the water like a dumb animal.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: Don't listen to this... thing! His cries are those of a mad beast caught in a thicket! He gave no mercy to my family, and I will give none to his.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: We warned you at Syracuse, and you persisted.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: You took advantage of us at New Canaan to drive us out, and like the dogs of Caesar you are, you followed us to Zion.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: And now you stand on holy ground, a temple to God's glory on Earth. But the only use for an animal in our temple is sacrifice!

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: Kale watcha nei conserva oh! You understand me, don't you? Don't you?!

Speaker: Salt-Upon-Wounds
Topic_Name: Whatever. Joshua, put a cap in General Gobbledigook here.
EN: {Killer!}{Bye-KAH kur}Baika-ker! You devil!

Speaker: Salt-Upon-Wounds
Topic_Name: You're right. We're going to kill you, but not like this. Defend yourself!
EN: {You can't fight me!}{YOO-can no ni-KUM-pah mee}Yoocan no nikumpa me! {Die, you!}{deh-YAI, you!}Deyai-yoo!

Speaker: Salt-Upon-Wounds
Topic_Name: Whoa. This isn't what I signed up for. Let me talk to Joshua about this.
EN: Him hear you. You talk!

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: God be with you.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: Thank you for this. I know Daniel doesn't approve, but destroying the White Legs is the only way to ensure the Sorrows can remain in Zion.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: You and I will lead a group of Dead Horse warriors and Sorrows hunters into Three Marys from this position.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: Our objective is to find the White Legs' leader, Salt-Upon-Wounds, and prevent him from fleeing.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: Show no quarter to the White Legs we come across. Make no mistake about why we are here. This is an extermination.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: I prefer to travel alone, thanks.
EN: The lone Bighorner is the most vulnerable to its enemies. In the herd lies strength - if you reconsider your choice, I will be here. {in peace, go}{PAHZ pah-tah-soo-ba}Paz patasooba.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: Before we depart, our shaman, White Bird, asked me to convey his desire to speak with you.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: Certainly. We should make haste, then.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: < Follows-Chalk bark about tree trunk containers >
EN: Hold up, see that log over there? Take a closer look. There might be some good stuff tucked in there.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: What would you suggest I do instead?
EN: Hmm... you might try luring the baby out with some banana yucca. These Bighorners go crazy for the stuff.

Speaker: Stella
Topic_Name: What do you know about the White Legs?
EN: Used to be they raided northeast of Caliente, time to time. But then the Desert Rangers fell apart ten years ago, absorbed into the NCR.

Speaker: Stella
Topic_Name: What do you know about the White Legs?
EN: Soon enough the White Legs were swarming all over that stretch of I-15. Folks learned not to head north if they wanted to keep their scalps.

Speaker: Stella
Topic_Name: What do you know about the White Legs?
EN: Eventually the White Legs destroyed the bridges across the Virgin River, over in Arizona. End of discussion.

Speaker: Stella
Topic_Name: Were the 80s a gang, or a tribe?
EN: What's the difference? Raiders is raiders.

Speaker: Stella
Topic_Name: Were the 80s a gang, or a tribe?
EN: Bunch of them swept in to town and dragged off two working girls. Deputies and me gave pursuit, straight into 80s territory.

Speaker: Stella
Topic_Name: Were the 80s a gang, or a tribe?
EN: By the time we caught up with the girls, there wasn't much left of them. So we turned for home.

Speaker: Stella
Topic_Name: Were the 80s a gang, or a tribe?
EN: Made it back to Caliente without further losses, but we was watched the whole way. Never seen so few people cover so much land. Goddamn creepy.

Speaker: Stella
Topic_Name: Were the 80s a gang, or a tribe?
EN: If the 80s had wanted to kill us, we would've been dead. Guess they figured we weren't worth the trouble.

Speaker: Stella
EN: Place lived up to its name, that's for sure.

Speaker: Stella
EN: When you got fresh water and a trickle of geothermic power, always be some gang of assholes wants to kill you for it.

Speaker: Stella
EN: Spent more years and took more bullets than I care to admit protecting that hellhole from dangers, within and without.

Speaker: Stella
EN: If it wasn't the 80s or the White Legs raiding, it was someone from town drunk off his ass trying to win an argument with a shotgun.

Speaker: Stella
EN: Got tired of shooting the folks I was supposed to protect. So... now I do this.

Speaker: Stella
Topic_Name: What was that like to grow up in New Reno?
EN: Imagine New Vegas if there was no Mr. House-type fella keeping the peace, then give everybody a gun and a Jet addiction.

Speaker: Stella
Topic_Name: What was that like to grow up in New Reno?
EN: Town's run by a bunch of crime families, no law to speak of. Make trouble, and you wind up buried in Golgotha, outside town.

Speaker: Stella
Topic_Name: What was that like to grow up in New Reno?
EN: The scuzz factor's off the charts. Non-stop whoring and drugs. Couldn't walk down the street without getting asked to star in a porn movie.

Speaker: Stella
Topic_Name: What was that like to grow up in New Reno?
EN: So I got my ass out of there while I still owned it. Guess I figured the answer to every problem was rule of law. Naive, huh?

Speaker: Stella
EN: Earning my keep. Jed hired me on as a caravan guard for this expedition of his.

Speaker: Stella
EN: The work suits me. I've tried staying put in one place, but it never works out.

Speaker: Stella
EN: Grew up in New Reno, and I couldn't put that snakepit behind me fast enough.

Speaker: Stella
EN: Then I wound up wasting the prime of my life playing Sheriff in Caliente, little town north on the 93. Talk about a pain in the ass.

Speaker: Stella
EN: You ask me, best to keep moving. At least the scenery changes.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Sorry, but I'm not going on a scavenger hunt for you.
EN: The choice is yours, of course, but you're not going to find a way back to the Mojave without our help.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: I'll see what I can do.
EN: Thank you. Follows-Chalk can help you find your way around the valley.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: I'll see what I can do.
EN: He's inexperienced, but he knows enough of our language to ignore the taboos about Pre-War buildings.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: I'll see what I can do.
EN: Thank you. Now obviously, taboos against Pre-War buildings won't be a matter for you - but take caution when you go rooting around in them.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: The Sorrows believe in a spirit that lives in the caves, say the spirit punished them once for trespassing.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: They put special marks around the cave entrances to keep people out. It doesn't work on the White Legs, of course, but the Dead Horses are spooked.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Why don't you or Daniel do it?
EN: We are responsible for leading and protecting the Sorrows and Dead Horses. They are smart people, but not as worldly as you or I.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Why don't you or Daniel do it?
EN: I am preparing the Dead Horses for war and Daniel is preparing the Sorrows for... other things.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: How about I go find dear Daniel and shake the information out of him?
EN: There are many reasons why that would be a bad idea. I will illuminate three.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: How about I go find dear Daniel and shake the information out of him?
EN: First, do not believe that because Daniel is a missionary he is incapable of or unwilling to defend himself.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: How about I go find dear Daniel and shake the information out of him?
EN: Second, if you harm Daniel or any of the Sorrows or Dead Horses, I will find you. Make no mistake. God willing, you will not leave this valley.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: How about I go find dear Daniel and shake the information out of him?
EN: Lastly, waging war against good people is bad for the soul. This may not seem important to you now, but it's the most important thing I've said.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Don't try to get me to help you. I'm not interested.
EN: There are only so many ways you could have entered Zion from the south. You descended by routes that you cannot safely ascend to return to the Mojave.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Don't try to get me to help you. I'm not interested.
EN: I'm not telling you this as a trick. Whether you want to help us or not, you can't get back without Daniel's assistance.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Don't try to get me to help you. I'm not interested.
EN: I'm sure he'll be willing to assist you, but we have other responsibilities at the moment.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
ActorNotes: [referring to the parable of the good samaritan]
Topic_Name: I'm not going to leave without offering to help. What can I do?
EN: {referring to the parable of the good samaritan}You're a good neighbor to us. We all go through periods of darkness. In such times, we can turn to the Lord, but it's good to have friends.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: I'm not going to leave without offering to help. What can I do?
EN: Daniel and I need Pre-War tools to help us navigate beyond Zion. Should we need to evacuate, these instruments will be vital to us.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: I'm not going to leave without offering to help. What can I do?
EN: Normally, we would have some of the Dead Horses or Sorrows look for them, but many Pre-War buildings in the valley are taboo. They won't go inside.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: In the Great Basin and Colorado Plateau, all tribes are known for a specific weapon.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: White Legs are known for their big submachine guns, "storm drums." They broke into an armory near Spanish Fork and have been using them for years.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: Of course, the Dead Horses have their wooden war clubs and even the Sorrows have their Yao Guai gauntlets.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: This type of .45 Automatic pistol was designed by one of my tribe almost four hundred years ago. Learning its use is a New Canaanite rite of passage.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Pray? God? What are you talking about?
EN: I am a New Canaanite. We believe we are the heirs of a spiritual tradition given to our ancestors thousands of years ago.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Pray? God? What are you talking about?
EN: We have made and kept covenants with our Lord, God, to honor his laws. In exchange, we are promised eternal salvation after this life.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Pray? God? What are you talking about?
EN: A day will come when our Lord returns to judge us all. Until then, we must honor his laws and start others along the path of salvation if we can.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Pray? God? What are you talking about?
EN: That's why we trade with others and work the tribes. We have more than food and medicine to offer. Good news is our most valuable commodity.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: How do I get out of here?
EN: Even though you made your way in, there's no easy way back. Without a map, you'll die in the wilderness.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: How do I get out of here?
EN: Daniel, one of our missionaries, can help you, but you've caught us at an... inconvenient time. We're under continual threat from the White Legs.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: I came here with the Happy Trails Caravan Company to make contact with the New Canaanites.
EN: Happy Trails. {quietly remembering}I remember. {small smile}They were good friends.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: I came here with the Happy Trails Caravan Company to make contact with the New Canaanites.
EN: {darker}I have bad news for your employers. New Canaan was destroyed, its citizens scattered. All because of the White Legs. And Caesar, of course.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: I came here with the Happy Trails Caravan Company to make contact with the New Canaanites.
EN: The White Legs want to join the Legion. Caesar's rite of passage is the destruction of the New Canaanites, almost assuredly because of me.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: I came here with the Happy Trails Caravan Company to make contact with the New Canaanites.
EN: The good news is that we can help you find your way back. Daniel, one of the other New Canaanites, has made many maps of the region.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: I came here with the Happy Trails Caravan Company to make contact with the New Canaanites.
EN: The bad news is that we can't help you right now. Not with everything that's going on.

Speaker: Ricky
EN: {laughs uncomfortably}Well, yeah, okay. You caught me.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: You're lying. You've never been to Vault 22.

Speaker: Ricky
EN: Yeah, so don't bring it up again!

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Sorry - didn't mean to be pushy.

Speaker: Ricky
EN: {laughs uncomfortably}Well, yeah, okay. You caught me.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: You're lying. You have no idea where Vault 22 is.

Speaker: Ricky
EN: Yeah, so don't bring it up again!

Speaker: Player / Courier

EN: Happy are those who do the work of the Lord. Zion belongs to God and the people of God. It is a natural temple and monument to his glory.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: This conversation just got pretty dark. What was that about happy... dashing the little ones?
EN: When our Lord entered the temple and found it polluted by money-changers and beasts, did he {emph.}ask them to leave? Did he cry? Did he simply walk away?

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: This conversation just got pretty dark. What was that about happy... dashing the little ones?
EN: No. He {emph.}drove them out. It is one thing to forgive a slap across my cheek, but an insult to the Lord requires... no, it {emph.}demands correction.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: You don't want to leave Zion. You'd rather kill every last one of the White Legs.
EN: Given those two choices, yes. In the best of all possible worlds, they would just leave us in peace. But they won't.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: You don't want to leave Zion. You'd rather kill every last one of the White Legs.
EN: I don't enjoy killing, but when done righteously, it's just a chore, like any other.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: You don't want to leave Zion. You'd rather kill every last one of the White Legs.
EN: Practiced hands make for short work. And the good Lord knows there's much to be done here.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: No, and I don't really care.
EN: Living in willful ignorance is an ugly thing, but God often speaks loudest in the wild places of his creation, like Zion.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: No, and I don't really care.
EN: Zion is a place, and a state of being, that has been lost to us several times in the past. Each loss is a new fall of man.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: No, and I don't really care.
EN: And after each fall, we weep in strange new lands and dream of Zion, dream of visiting vengeance upon those who took it from us.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: No, and I don't really care.
EN: But this is the waking world in which we live. There is no need to cry, no need to dream. We can act now and stop the White Legs here.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Well, I'm guessing you're pretty mad about something.
EN: The White Legs didn't just force my people out of New Canaan. They butchered everyone who wasn't fast enough to get away.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Well, I'm guessing you're pretty mad about something.
EN: The elderly, the ill, children. Those who stopped to help the wounded. It made no difference to them. They can't be reasoned with, the White Legs.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Well, I'm guessing you're pretty mad about something.
EN: Daniel believes that if we leave, if the Sorrows leave, the White Legs will stop. He doesn't understand what this kind of tribe is like.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Are the New Canaanites really a tribe?
EN: We wear more clothing than them and understand more about technology, but we're still a tribe, a linked family of families.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Are the New Canaanites really a tribe?
EN: The Boneyard, Phoenix, New Vegas, they're just places, metal and stone. New Canaan dies, but the tribe lives on.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Are the New Canaanites really a tribe?
EN: When the walls come tumbling down, when you lose everything you have, you always have family. And your family always has tribe.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Why haven't I seen any Sorrows in the valley?
EN: The Sorrows have many skilled hunters among them, but no warriors. They have not had to deal with war or raiders for decades.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Why haven't I seen any Sorrows in the valley?
EN: Even though they can hunt a full-grown Yao Guai, they don't know how to deal with the White Legs. That's why we're here.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Does the valley belong to the Dead Horses?
EN: The valley belongs to God, but no. The Dead Horses live at Dead Horse Point, up the Colorado River. They came here because I asked them to.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Does the valley belong to the Dead Horses?
EN: Before I... returned to the fold, I visited them years earlier. I looked much different then, but I left an impression on them.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Does the valley belong to the Dead Horses?
EN: I taught them how to hunt more efficiently, how to maintain their weapons and Pre-War equipment. When I returned, they showed their appreciation.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Why did the White Legs attack my caravan?
EN: They attack everyone who isn't a White Leg, especially caravans. They don't know how to survive on their own, so they have to raid.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Why did the White Legs attack my caravan?
EN: But as for why they are here, they are trying to wipe us out. All of us.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Why did the White Legs attack my caravan?
EN: They want to join Caesar's Legion, and they can only prove their worth by destroying the New Canaanites and everyone we shelter.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: Every day. Some days are... harder than others.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Ha ha ha! Wait... you don't actually believe that, do you?
EN: I know it may be hard for you to accept or even to understand. In my heart, I believe that though I am a sinner, I have been saved.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Ha ha ha! Wait... you don't actually believe that, do you?
EN: And I believe there is something beyond this rock and this air and this water around us, something more that is waiting for us.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Ha ha ha! Wait... you don't actually believe that, do you?
EN: I have been baptized twice, once in water, once in flame. I will carry the fire of the holy spirit inside until I stand before my Lord for judgment.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: Whether there is a God or not, his existence doesn't depend on what you believe or what I say.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: There is much to be skeptical of in this world, so it no longer surprises me to learn how many people don't really believe in anything.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: But I believe that our Lord was made flesh as Jesus Christ and died to redeem me. And you. And the Sorrows. Even the White Legs. Everyone.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: In a world filled with misery and uncertainty, it is a great comfort to know that, in the end, there is light in the darkness.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: Every day, we move closer to our judgment. We must do our best to walk in the footsteps of our Lord and teach others how to do the same.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: For many of us, the road is a difficult one, but the path is always there for us to follow, no matter how many times we may fall.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: What's going on with all of these... tribes?
EN: A great deal. There are three, make that four, tribes here in Zion. You've already met the White Legs on the way in.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: What's going on with all of these... tribes?
EN: In this camp, you'll find Dead Horses. In the Narrows, the Sorrows. And finally there's Daniel and myself. We're New Canaanites.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Do you run the show around here?
EN: I wouldn't say that. I am the acting war chief for the Dead Horses. They look up to me for such matters, but I only have the authority they give me.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Do you run the show around here?
EN: Daniel is the spiritual leader and main link of the New Canaanites to the Sorrows. He's up in the Narrows right now.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: Of course.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: Most don't. It's been hundreds of years since the war. They've developed their own languages.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: Take the Dead Horses. We think they were originally refugees from a place called {"rehz"}"Res," east of the Grand Canyon.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: They speak a combination of Res and a language spoken by travelers who were visiting Res when the bombs fell. Over time, the two languages blended.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: I was a translator years ago, but it's hard to keep up with all of the tribal variations.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Thanks for the offer, but I'll handle it myself.
EN: I don't think so.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: The Divide blocked all of their northern land routes?
EN: Not all of them. But they couldn't take 127 north to get around the mountains.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: The Divide blocked all of their northern land routes?
EN: As if Death Valley weren't enough, they had the Divide and Big Empty to deal with.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: The Divide blocked all of their northern land routes?
EN: From what the Legion's explorers reported, the Big Empty may as well have been a wall to any living thing approaching it.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: I don't know for certain, and I don't think NCR knows, either. Whatever happened at the Divide was too much for them to handle.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: Our {froo-mehn-tah-ree}frumentarii told us what they saw. Only fools and madmen would march into a place like that. All roads wind down to the same spot, the grave.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: They said all that's left there is a gaping wound cut into the Earth, cursed and damned. No place for God-fearing folk.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: I'm guessing you don't like Caesar very much.
EN: Love the sinner, hate the sin. With Caesar, it's often very difficult to see through all of that sin to the person inside.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: I'm guessing you don't like Caesar very much.
EN: I can say that we were both lucky that NCR's supply lines and land routes north of Mojave Outpost were destroyed before the Battle of Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: I'm guessing you don't like Caesar very much.
EN: Something bad happened near Death Valley, at a place called the Divide. NCR couldn't cut across anymore and it slowed down their reinforcements.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: I'm guessing you don't like Caesar very much.
EN: Terrible storms ripped entire companies apart before they even got to Nevada soil. The aftermath of Hoover Dam could have been even worse for Caesar.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Do you know about Mr. House?
EN: I had heard of him, but when we were preparing to enter the Mojave, he didn't seem relevant to what was happening.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Do you know about Mr. House?
EN: From what I've learned since Hoover Dam, he handled the Mojave tribes in a fashion not entirely dissimilar from Caesar. It's too bad.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: What do you think of NCR?
EN: Better than Caesar, but that's not a high standard. Too much love of money and ownership, not enough love of God and giving.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: What do you think of NCR?
EN: Any society that derives its power and authority from the will of man alone lives apart from God and will crumble in the end.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: What do you know about the war between Caesar and NCR?
EN: I try not to involve myself with matters of the Mojave anymore. All I know is from before the Battle of Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Are you in much pain? Is there anything I can do to help?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] You are kind to offer, but no, there's nothing you can do. We don't use chems, but I learned long ago that I'm immune to their effects.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Are you in much pain? Is there anything I can do to help?
EN: It never stops burning. My skin. Every day, I have to unwind the bandages and replace them with fresh ones.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Are you in much pain? Is there anything I can do to help?
EN: Exposing my body to the air is like living through it again. But it's better to be clean than comfortable.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: I survived because the fire inside burned brighter than the fire around me. I fell down into that dark chasm, but the flame burned on and on.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: The next morning, I woke up and crawled out of the northern edge of the Grand Canyon, that cursed place. It took me three months to reach New Canaan.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: It was as though the prodigal son had returned. They welcomed me like I had never left, never done anything to shame them.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: The fire that had kept me alive was love. Their love. God's love. I will never be able to repay the debt I owe to them, but I must try.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: How did you end up as Caesar's legate?
EN: This way lies the path to hell. Edw- Caesar needed me to translate. Translation became giving orders. Giving orders became leading in battle.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: How did you end up as Caesar's legate?
EN: Leading in battle became training, punishing, terrorizing. A series of small mistakes before a great fall.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: How did you end up as Caesar's legate?
EN: And I stayed in that darkness until after Hoover Dam. After I failed Caesar and he had me burned alive, thrown into the Grand Canyon.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Was one of those men Caesar?
EN: No, not then. Back then he was just Edward. Smart man. Young, but we all were. We thought we could hike into the Grand Canyon and talk to Blackfoots.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Was one of those men Caesar?
EN: We did, and the Blackfoots were friendly enough at first, but eventually... I've thought back to that day so many times. I must have mistranslated.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Was one of those men Caesar?
EN: Something must have been mixed up, because the Blackfoots decided we weren't going to leave. The rest is history, assuming Edward hasn't changed it.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: [FAILED] {irritated}For injuries I suffered long ago.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Were you always with the New Canaanites?
EN: I was born in Ogden, what people came to call New Canaan. Things were more peaceful when I was growing up.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Were you always with the New Canaanites?
EN: When I was a young man, I went out into the world to do missionary work as all New Canaanites do.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Were you always with the New Canaanites?
EN: I traveled along the Long 15 and followed 89 south into Arizona. Along the way, I met two men from a group called the Followers of the Apocalypse.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Were you always with the New Canaanites?
EN: Edward Sallow and Bill Calhoun. They came to teach the tribes. Calhoun was a good man. Edward was the one who got us into trouble down the road.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Can I ask you some personal questions?
EN: Right now, I'd like you to focus on helping Daniel. Maybe there will be time later.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Can I ask you some personal questions?
EN: It's not something I enjoy, but I pray to God that someone may learn from my mistakes. What would you like to know?

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: God be with you.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Do you have anything to trade?
EN: We do. Though the White Legs destroyed New Canaan, they didn't destroy all of our supply caches.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Do you have anything to trade?
EN: All forms of currency are recognized here. Caps, NCR dollars, even Legion coin. Take a look.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Do you have anything to trade?
EN: Yes. Take a look.

Speaker: Stella
EN: {angry that Jed dismissed your concerns}{under your breath}Sorry to bother you with reality, ol' Jed. Who cares if we can't get back out the way we come?  That's not a problem.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
ActorNotes: [Jed becomes alerted by a sound ahead of the party. Stops dead on his tracks, cautious.]
EN: {Jed becomes alerted by a sound ahead of the party. Stops dead on his tracks, cautious.} Shhhhh! Hold on, now...{finger to his lips, he shushes the rest of the crew.} Could swear I heard something up ahead.

Speaker: Happy Trails Caravan Guard
ActorNotes: [Takes initiative, and moves forward to explore threat.]
EN: {Takes initiative, and moves forward to explore threat.}I'll take a look, boss! Keep me covered!

Speaker: Jed Masterson
ActorNotes: [Notices the player being hit, and falling down, and rushes to aid]
EN: {Notices the player being hit, and falling down, and rushes to aid}On your feet! Keep fighting!{helps player on her/his feet} Come on now, I got ya...

Speaker: Stella
ActorNotes: [Blinded by anger, Stella charges forth against the ambushers.]
EN: {Blinded by anger, Stella charges forth against the ambushers.}Enough of this! We're sitting ducks here! {pauses to catch her breath}Here I come! I was a sheriff once, goddamn it!

Speaker: Stella
ActorNotes: [Ticked off by Ricky, and the ambush, she grinds her teeth]
EN: {Ticked off by Ricky, and the ambush, she grinds her teeth}Shut the hell up, Ricky! Might as well be waving at them!

Speaker: Ricky
ActorNotes: [Whimpering, cowardly trying to hide from incoming fire.]
EN: {Whimpering, cowardly trying to hide from incoming fire.}I don't deserve this! My Pip-Boy don't even work! Why the fuck you hire me?

Speaker: Ricky
EN: {High, recklessly shooting in all directions.}You want some, assholes? You just pissed off the wrong guy! And that means Ricky!

Speaker: Happy Trails Caravan Guard
ActorNotes: [Alarmed, just recognized that they've been ambushed]
EN: {Alarmed, just recognized that they've been ambushed}Ambush! Tribals, and they mean blood!

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Notices Stella falling down}Stella!... Oh no! {as he runs to her fallen body, small pause}Don't you die on me, woman, you hear?

Speaker: Jed Masterson
ActorNotes: [Trying to calm his crew under an onslaught of fire, and flying tomahawks.]
EN: {Trying to calm his crew under an onslaught of fire, and flying tomahawks.}Holy hell! Stay low, people, stay low...

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Alarmed, recognizes that they've been ambushed}Goddammit, ambush! Cover, people! Watch yourselves!

Speaker: Stella
EN: {Ricky is going through withdrawal}Didn't nobody do this to you but yourself, junkie. Now try suffering in silence for once.

Speaker: Ricky
EN: {self-pitying}You ain't got no heart, Stella! I swear, you're a monster, and you're gonna regret treating me like this!

Speaker: Stella
EN: {Ricky is whining}You ain't sick! You're a goddamn junkie, that's what you are! So shut it!

Speaker: Ricky
EN: {going through withdrawal}{sob of self-pity}You don't know how this feels, Stella! I'm sick! Never been so sick my whole life!

Speaker: Stella
EN: {Ricky is whining}Enough! Another word of your bitching and I'll put you out of your misery myself!

Speaker: Stella
EN: {fed up, under your breath}Goddammit, never should joined this assbackwards caravan...

Speaker: Ricky
EN: Dream on, {mocking}Stella. Ricky ain't about to die for nobody. Ricky's fucking in-vin-cible, yessir!{chuckle}

Speaker: Stella
ActorNotes: [Ricky just boasted he has plenty of drugs]
EN: {Ricky just boasted he has plenty of drugs}Sounds like you got enough for a fatal overdose, then. Do us all a favor, will ya?

Speaker: Stella
ActorNotes: [Ricky has Fixer to handle his addiction]
EN: {Ricky has Fixer to handle his addiction}Best fix for you'd be a bullet in the brainpan. Now shut it.

Speaker: Ricky
EN: Don't worry, {mocking}Stella! This was my last hit, but thanks to ol' Johnny-come-lately over there, Ricky got some Fixer to take the edge off.

Speaker: Ricky
EN: Don't worry, {mocking}Stella! This was my last hit, but thanks to ol' Janey-come-lately over there, Ricky got some Fixer to take the edge off.

Speaker: Ricky
EN: Don't worry, {mocking}Stella! Ol' Ricky won't be running out of Psycho any time soon! Ol' Ricky's downright flush! Yes indeed!

Speaker: Stella
EN: {Ricky is yelling}Shut your mouth, you goddamn junkie! Or I'll plant one between your shoulder blades, I swear!

Speaker: Stella
EN: {to yourself, under your breath}{continuing imaginary conversation with Jed, mocking him}"That's right, little lady. Everything will be just fine with Jed to protect you. Quite the leader is what I am, hell yes."

Speaker: Stella
EN: {to yourself, under your breath}{continuing conversation with imaginary Jed}Oh I'm sure you're right, Jed. What's the worst can happen to us out here? Nothing. Perfectly safe, fucking perfectly...

Speaker: Stella
EN: {to yourself, under your breath}{mocking Jed}"Heard you the fifteenth time, Stella. What's it matter if we're trapped here? Everything will be just fine."

Speaker: Daniel
EN: {Narration - Daniel died}In the shadow of Daniel's death, those Sorrows who survived the assault on Zion Valley mourned his loss, as was their custom.

Speaker: Daniel
EN: {Narration}Word of Daniel's passing reached the New Canaanites several weeks later. They prayed that their brother would be well-received by their Lord.

Speaker: Daniel
EN: {Narration - Flight from Zion}After leading the Sorrows from their home in Zion to safety in Grand Staircase, Daniel continued to wonder if he'd made the right choice.

Speaker: Daniel
EN: {Narration}He spent his life evangelizing the beliefs of his people to a new generation of young men and women, as his ancestors had for centuries before him.

Speaker: Daniel
EN: {Narration}He was happy with his family, but for the rest of his life there were nights when he awoke with sadness to find he had been dreaming of Zion.

Speaker: Daniel
EN: {Narration - Crush the White Legs}For years after the defeat of the White Legs, Daniel did his best to minister to the Sorrows' spiritual needs.

Speaker: Daniel
EN: {Narration}Try as he might, he could not hold back the tribe's increasing militancy and reverence of Joshua Graham.

Speaker: Daniel
EN: {Narration}Demoralized, he returned to his family and Dead Horse Point. His failures haunted him for the rest of his days.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: {Narration - Joshua died}After a long and troubled life, Joshua Graham finally found rest in Zion.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: {Narration}In the end, his unswerving militancy had accomplished what the NCR's finest sharpshooters and Caesar's wrath could not.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: {Narration}The New Canaanites took comfort in the belief that their brother's soul would again dwell in Zion at the end of days.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
ActorNotes: [Narration - Crush the White Legs, SUW spared]
EN: {Narration - Crush the White Legs, SUW spared}The threat of the White Legs ended, Joshua Graham helped the Sorrows and Dead Horses tend to their fallen comrades and secure Zion.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: {Narration}The Courier's words had stayed Joshua's wrath in his darkest hour, and in sparing Salt-Upon-Wounds, he was changed.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: {Narration}While he continued to advocate militant opposition to the enemies of New Canaan, he sometimes showed quarter to those who crossed his family.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: {Narration}Eventually this new spirit would diminish the myth of the Burned Man in distant lands - a small price for the peace it brought to Joshua Graham.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
ActorNotes: [Narration - Crush the White Legs, SUW executed]
EN: {Narration - Crush the White Legs, SUW executed}With the White Legs crushed, Joshua Graham led the Sorrows and Dead Horses in tearing apart and burning the corpses of their enemies.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: {Narration}He set about training his army in the "Way of the Canaanite," and soon the New Canaanites and tribes of Zion were feared well into the Mojave.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: {Narration}Legends of the Burned Man grew even more depraved, and terrifying.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
ActorNotes: [Narration - Crush the White Legs, SUW defeated in combat]
EN: {Narration - Crush the White Legs, SUW defeated in combat}Though the Courier had stopped Joshua Graham from executing Salt-Upon-Wounds, the war chief still fell in battle.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: {Narration}The White Legs defeated at Three Marys, Joshua led the Sorrows and Dead Horses in tending to their comrades and burning the corpses of their foes.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: {Narration}He continued to advocate militant opposition to the enemies of New Canaan and showed little quarter to those he fought. And yet he was changed.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: {Narration}He no longer reveled in the brutality and cruelty for which he had been known in his former life.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: {Narration}His inner demons, if not extinguished, were at the least... {slight beat}appeased.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: {Narration - Daniel hides the truth}Waking Cloud turned bitter and resentful toward Daniel and the New Canaanites when she learned her husband's death had been concealed from her.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: {Narration}She poisoned some of her tribe against New Canaanite teachings, making relations between the groups difficult from time to time.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: {Narration - Daniel tells Waking Cloud}Waking Cloud was distraught when she learned of her husband's death, but took comfort from her tribe, and the compassion of the New Canaanites.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: {Narration}She forgave Daniel for having concealed her husband's fate from her, and learned to accept his fate.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: {Narration}When her grief faded, she took a husband from the Dead Horse tribe. At her bidding, he stayed close to home.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: {Narration - Civilization's bad}Follows-Chalk took the Courier's words to heart and decided that the big cities of the Mojave Wasteland and NCR were best left unexplored.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: {Narration}Though he sometimes dreamed of distant lands, he continued to support his family at Dead Horse Point, and eventually his wanderlust faded.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: {Narration - Civilization is cool}Follows-Chalk took the Courier's words to heart and decided that he would behold the sights and sounds of distant lands with his own eyes and ears.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: {Narration}After returning to Dead Horse Point, he quarreled with his family and other tribe members about his ambitions.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: {Narration}One morning, they awoke to discover that Follows-Chalk had set off alone, westward, into the wilderness.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: {Narration}He was never seen again.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration - Daniel killed}Already weakened by several seasons of bad trading, the Happy Trails Caravan Company was devastated by the failure of its expedition.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration}The New Canaanites never reestablished ties with the caravan.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration}Their experiences with outsiders near the Great Salt Lake and in Zion had been far too negative.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration}Within six months, the Happy Trails Caravan Company was bankrupted and dissolved.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration - Flight from Zion}Already weakened by several seasons of bad trading, the Happy Trails Caravan Company was initially discouraged by the results of its expedition.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration}The fate of New Canaan, and the evacuation of the Sorrows from Zion, made the prospect of trading seem fruitless.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration}When Daniel told his family about the exploits of Happy Trails' employee, the Courier, however, New Canaan decided to repay the company's kindness.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration}Twice per year, New Canaanites made the dangerous journey west to trade with the company in the city of New Reno.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration}The Happy Trails Caravan Company could not survive on such trading alone, but the New Canaanite's generosity made tough times go easier.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration - Crush the White Legs}The defeat of the White Legs in Zion marked a turning point in the fortunes of the Happy Trails Caravan Company.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration}Every two months, the caravan met with the New Canaanites in Zion Valley to trade. Happy Trails soon returned to prosperity.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration}The vigilance of the Sorrows and Dead Horses in defending southwestern Utah, initially startling to Happy Trails caravans, soon proved a blessing.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration}The tribes united against the 80s, driving them back from Highway 50, and thus opening yet another trading route for Happy Trails caravans.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: {Narration - Joshua Dead}Having revered Joshua Graham as a living legend for so many years, the Dead Horses found it difficult to accept his death.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: {Narration}New Canaanite missionaries sought to remain in contact with the tribe, but lacking Joshua's authority, their influence dwindled.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: {Narration}Still, as an expression of enduring respect for their lost spiritual leader, the Dead Horses helped protect the lands where New Canaanites settled.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
