Topic_Name: And you have the right to pull them off of their land?
EN: What are you going to tell them about how to live with themselves after they got lost in the moment, killed someone who didn't {emph}deserve to die?

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: And you have the right to pull them off of their land?
EN: Or does that not matter? Is that just an acceptable consquence if it means holding on to this valley?

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: And you have the right to pull them off of their land?
EN: Maybe there is no place left in this world for mercy. But even if it tramples me into the dust, I will never accept it. And I will never condone it.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: And you have the right to pull them off of their land?
EN: Joshua must be waiting for you. I'll stay here with the others as I told them I would.

Speaker: Daniel
EN: Of course.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: Why won't you tell me about what happened at New Canaan?
EN: It's not a subject I'm fond of discussing. It's over and done with, anyway. Why are you so interested?

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: I'd like to talk to you about Mordecai.
EN: {emph}I'd like you to drop it. It's a private matter.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: I understand. Let's talk about something else.
EN: Thanks. What would you like to know?

Speaker: Daniel
EN: [FAILED] It's understandable, but this is something for me to work out with the Lord. And I hope you can understand that.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: You're the man in charge. If something's troubling you, it could affect all of us.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] I never thought I'd be in charge of anything. Don't know why. Bishop Mordecai was old. He had been sick for years.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: You're the man in charge. If something's troubling you, it could affect all of us.
EN: He couldn't walk anymore. It wasn't a problem for the rest of us. {laughing a bit}He made it out to be more trouble than it really was. Just his way, I guess.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: You're the man in charge. If something's troubling you, it could affect all of us.
EN: When the White Legs came... {sigh}he was upstairs. We couldn't get him out in time. The house caught fire at the base and worked its way up. Fast.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: You're the man in charge. If something's troubling you, it could affect all of us.
EN: He didn't die of smoke. I wish he had. Sometimes I wake up and for a minute or two, I think all of it was a dream. But it's not. It wasn't.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: You're the man in charge. If something's troubling you, it could affect all of us.
EN: I wish all of this were some fevered vision of what could have been. Instead of what is, what we let happen.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: Why don't you teach them something useful instead of filling their heads with nonsense?
EN: We teach them practical skills for this life and we prepare them for what's to come.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: Why don't you teach them something useful instead of filling their heads with nonsense?
EN: The Sorrows could master all the wonders of the Old World. conquer the Great Basin north to south. But without God's love, they would have nothing.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: Why don't you teach them something useful instead of filling their heads with nonsense?
EN: It is shelter in the storm, food in times of hunger, warmth and light in the cold and darkness. What can compare to that in value and versatility?

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: Why don't you teach them something useful instead of filling their heads with nonsense?
EN: You don't agree. That's your choice. It can be their choice, too. No one is forced to follow the narrow path.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: Sounds kind of far-fetched, even for the wasteland.
EN: Good news is an amazing thing in this world we've {emph}unmade. We're so used to going to sleep with nightmares that we can't imagine waking up to a dream.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: Sounds kind of far-fetched, even for the wasteland.
EN: But that's what we believe, every word of it. It's the cornerstone of our faith and how we choose to live.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: Sounds kind of far-fetched, even for the wasteland.
EN: With every step {emph}you take, you put one foot in front of the other and {emph}know that you'll be pulled back down to this Earth.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: Sounds kind of far-fetched, even for the wasteland.
EN: {emph}We know that God is watching over us, waiting for us to come back home. To us, there's no difference. Walking and living. It's all belief, all faith.

Speaker: Daniel
EN: Heh. That's actually a better response than I usually get from wastelanders. No offense.

Speaker: Daniel
EN: Tell you what. There's a lot going on right now but why don't you take this. Read it. Maybe you'll hate it. Maybe you'll be bored.

Speaker: Daniel
EN: But if you have questions, assuming we get through all this, let me know. It used to be my job to answer those questions. Maybe it will be again.

Speaker: Daniel
EN: [FAILED] As far as you're concerned, it is. This really isn't the time to talk about it, all things considered.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: If you don't acknowledge your past now, it'll come back to you later.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] True enough. We can't escape it no matter how hard we try. Best we can do is own up, trust in the Lord to forgive.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: If you don't acknowledge your past now, it'll come back to you later.
EN: Joshua was gone, so were a lot of the other New Canaanites. White Legs must have been watching for a long while, counting who remained.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: If you don't acknowledge your past now, it'll come back to you later.
EN: We didn't think the White Legs were a real threat. Maybe it was overconfidence. Maybe sloth. Either way, we didn't see them coming.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: If you don't acknowledge your past now, it'll come back to you later.
EN: They attacked at night. They killed without regard to age or infirmity. Armed or unarmed. They beat children to-{cut off, overcome with emotion momentarily}

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: If you don't acknowledge your past now, it'll come back to you later.
EN: {pause}Beat them to death in their beds while they were sleeping. {pause}And now we're all that's left. Maybe thirty of us. {"lesson learned"}Pride goeth before destruction.

Speaker: Daniel
EN: Look, I've got a lot to do here. My personal relationship... it's not important right now. Can't see how it concerns you, anyway.

Speaker: Daniel
EN: {uncomfortable talking about it}We lost it. Our community, everything. But the past is gone. We have to look forward.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: The White Legs are here already, so what's your plan?
EN: To remove the Sorrows from harm's way. I have to give credit to the White Legs for finding their way here, though I imagine many died in the process.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: The White Legs are here already, so what's your plan?
EN: But they can't follow us east, not into the Grand Staircase. They don't know how to live off of the land. We head there, we can find some safety.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: Has this happened before, the White Legs attacking other tribes?
EN: Yes. But not just White Legs. Raiders too. Prospectors. Slavers. Anyone who thinks they can exploit the ignorant and the innocent.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: Has this happened before, the White Legs attacking other tribes?
EN: We lost the Tar Walkers. And the Crazy Horns. We did our best, but we made mistakes. We paid for them, but they paid more.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: Has this happened before, the White Legs attacking other tribes?
EN: I'd like to get out from under that debt someday. Until then, it's enough to stop ourselves from getting deeper in the hole.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: What does a bishop do? Is that your boss?
EN: Yeah, Bishop Mordecai is...

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: What does a bishop do? Is that your boss?
EN: {sad, remembering that he died}Sorry. Mordecai was my bishop. He was killed by White Legs during the attack on New Canaan. He was responsible for our congregation there.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: What does a bishop do? Is that your boss?
EN: I don't know who my next bishop will be. {resolved}But that's a problem for tomorrow. There are plenty of troubles here for us today.

Speaker: Daniel
EN: A spiritual wasteland, yes. We believe that before this life, our souls existed elsewhere. And after we die, our souls will leave this world.

Speaker: Daniel
EN: During our time here, we have the burden of choice. The choices we make determine where we go in the spirit world, and how we will face judgment.

Speaker: Daniel
EN: New Canaanites believe, as many once did, that God was made flesh here on Earth as a man named Jesus Christ. He sacrificed his life to save us.

Speaker: Daniel
EN: Every sin, every terrible thing that you, me, or any one of us have done for all time, was washed away by his blood. We just have to accept his love.

Speaker: Daniel
EN: That's why we visit the tribes, to spread the good news. For all we know, we New Canaanites may be all that remains of Christ's followers.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: You said you "used to" help the Sorrows with problems. What do you do now?
EN: I'm trying to make amends for allowing our problem to become their problem. The New Canaanites, I mean.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: You said you "used to" help the Sorrows with problems. What do you do now?
EN: The White Legs have always fought with us, and with Joshua returning, Caesar has motivated the White Legs to stamp out the New Canaanites entirely.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: You said you "used to" help the Sorrows with problems. What do you do now?
EN: That means the tribes we work with, too. It's already hap-{stopping himself} I just want to prevent something terrible from happening to the Sorrows.

Speaker: Daniel
EN: I used to help the Sorrows with various medical problems and general issues they were having, but my bishop sent me here as a missionary.

Speaker: Daniel
EN: We New Canaanites believe that there is a path to salvation for everyone and it's important that we set people on that path if they are willing.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: I had some other questions for you.
EN: What's on your mind?

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: Uh... you might want to have a chat with them. They think your "Lord" and the "Father" are the same.
EN: Oh. {realizing}Ah. {sighs}Of course. How stupid of me. They probably also think Mary is the mother and Jesus is the child.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: Uh... you might want to have a chat with them. They think your "Lord" and the "Father" are the same.
EN: No wonder they picked up on things so easily. I guess it just goes to show how difficult it is to communicate sometimes.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: What do you know about the Father in the Caves?
EN: Father in the? Oh, right. He's some spirit the Sorrows used to believe in, watched over them from the caves in the valley.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: What do you know about the Father in the Caves?
EN: They marked some of the caves around here because they think they'll be punished for going inside.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: What do you know about the Father in the Caves?
EN: I think as more of them learn the teachings of the New Canaanites, they'll lose their old superstitions.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: What did you say about a courier? Who were you expecting?
EN: Caesar would never admit this openly, but he knows that I'm alive. I've killed enough of his frumentarii and assassins that have come looking.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: What did you say about a courier? Who were you expecting?
EN: I've heard one of them travels the Mojave as a courier. Most of Caesar's agents meet a fitting end in NCR territory, but maybe this one survived.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Fine by me. I prefer the wilderness.
EN: Then let him know. Follows-Chalk needs more guidance in his life. I'd prefer it not come from me.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Fine by me. I prefer the wilderness.
EN: If people want to look to me for how to fight, I will show them how. I believe God put me on this Earth for that very reason.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Fine by me. I prefer the wilderness.
EN: But to live like me, think like me... no. There are better people for them to look to for such things.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: Whatever you tell him, I'm sure it will be fine.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: It's still his choice to make. I just want him to make it without looking to me for approval. He's a man. He can make his own decisions.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: You know that means I'm going to encourage him to leave, right?
EN: Follows-Chalk needs more guidance in his life. Just not from me.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Who are you to decide this?
EN: [FAILED] I am the right hand of the Lord and the instrument of his vengeance!

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: If what you believe is true, he'll pay for it later. The Sorrows don't need to see you do this.
EN: {initial anger}I want to take from them what they took from me, from my family. {becoming sad}In this life. I want them to suffer. I want all of them to die in fear and pain.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: If what you believe is true, he'll pay for it later. The Sorrows don't need to see you do this.
EN: I want to have my revenge. Against him. Against Caesar. I want to call it my own, to make my anger God's anger. To justify the things I've done.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: If what you believe is true, he'll pay for it later. The Sorrows don't need to see you do this.
EN: Sometimes I tell myself that these wild fires never stop burning. But I'm the one who starts them. Not God. Not them.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: If what you believe is true, he'll pay for it later. The Sorrows don't need to see you do this.
EN: I can always see it in my mind. The warmth and the heat. It will always be a part of me. {pause}But not today.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: If what you believe is true, he'll pay for it later. The Sorrows don't need to see you do this.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Go. Get out of here. Go back. Back to the Great Salt Lake.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: [FAILED] No! He and his tribe have worked hard for their wages. Who am I to deny them?

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: There. That's it. It's finished. When they hear what happened here, the White Legs will crawl back to their Great Salt Lake.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: If Caesar doesn't kill them, they'll wither and die like the cursed mongrels they are.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: Come. Let's find Daniel. Tomorrow will be here soon. And there is still much work to be done.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: {quietly}That's it. It's finished. Thank you for... staying with me. I couldn't have done this on my own.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: Let's go find Daniel. Tomorrow will be here soon. {beat}And there is much to do.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: It's the same end he would have met if he had died on his knees. But I suppose this was for the sake of the Dead Horses and Sorrows.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: Still, thanks to your help and the grace of God, the White Legs won't be troubling Zion anymore.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: Let's go find Daniel. Tomorrow will be here soon enough. And there is much to do.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: You don't think Lanius can lead the Legion?
EN: I think only Caesar can lead the Legion. I've never met anyone who could take his place. I couldn't. I never had a mind for logistics.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: You don't think Lanius can lead the Legion?
EN: I don't know Lanius, but from what I've heard, he has no interest in leading anyone unless it's in battle.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: You don't think Lanius can lead the Legion?
EN: No. The Legion dies with Caesar. What follows now are just the last steps of a man who does not yet realize that he's walking dead.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
EN: The Lord shall reveal all things in good time.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: They won't. I'll make sure the Legion has very little to go home with.
EN: Hmm. Good. You're doing God's work, whether you believe it or not.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Caesar is dead. I saw to it personally. I thought you should know.
EN: {pause}I have to admit, it's hard to believe. That even after all he did to me, all he {emph}tried to do to find and erase me from this world, he went first.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: Caesar is dead. I saw to it personally. I thought you should know.
EN: No doubt this will be good for the Mojave. I can only hope Arizona and the tribes don't suffer as the Legion falls apart around them.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: I've met Caesar, you know. What do you think he would say if I told him you were here?
EN: I think that would put him - and you - in a difficult position. Caesar has agents looking for me, but he won't admit I'm alive.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: I've met Caesar, you know. What do you think he would say if I told him you were here?
EN: And even if you killed me, he can't acknowledge that. To do so would be to admit I had never died. That Caesar made a mistake.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: I've met Caesar, you know. What do you think he would say if I told him you were here?
EN: No. He lives by his lies and shall die by his lies. There is no escaping it.

Speaker: Ricky
Topic_Name: I've got your number, that's all. Just wanted you to know.
EN: {unnerved, keeping voice down}Fine, just keep it to yourself, all right? Don't be such a fucking jerk about it.

Speaker: Dancing Flame
Topic_Name: Just wait here a few minutes. Don't do anything crazy.
EN: We wait, but not forever!

Speaker: Dancing Flame
Topic_Name: Sure, whatever. We go smash White Legs.
EN: We go!

Speaker: Dancing Flame
Topic_Name: Just get out of here, you're no match for hardened White Leg warriors.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Because you are friend to Sorrows... very well. We go. Angry ghosts will do for White Legs.

Speaker: Dancing Flame
Topic_Name: Just get out of here, you're no match for hardened White Leg warriors.
EN: [FAILED] No! We not let White Legs defile our ancestors! We go! We fight!

Speaker: Dancing Flame
Topic_Name: No, I smash White Legs alone. You stay here so you not get dead.
EN: Hmph. Since you are friend to Sorrows... we go. But you kill White Legs!

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: It is good to travel with another. I spend so long scouting on my own that I forget what human company is like.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: I have seen many strange plants in the valley - plants that seem to hunger for human flesh. Where they come from, I do not know.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: White Leg attacks grow more frequent each day - I fear for our people and for our valley if something is not done.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: {Praying to herself}Oh Father, guide and protect us your humble children as we labor in the vineyards, and make us strong to resist those who would steal Zion from us.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: I wish you could have met my family. You would like them, I think.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: Zion used to be a place of peace, you know. Daniel says that it is holy in the eyes of the Father. I hope someday you will see it as it was.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: {Praying}Father, I ask that you guide this man who is the vessel of your will. Show him the light of your wisdom and the peace of your love. Amen.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: {Praying}Father, I ask that you guide this woman who is the vessel of your will. Show her the light of your wisdom and the peace of your love. Amen.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: Daniel says that most people outside the valley do not keep to the Father's ways. Perhaps when you leave you will carry His word with you?

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: When Salt-Upon-Wounds took New Canaan, he ordered the White Legs to salt the earth so nothing could grow again. What kind of monster could do that?

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: I know you are eager to leave Zion, but... perhaps you might find peace if you stayed. Think about it, yes?

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: The river is lovely at this time of day, don't you think?

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: The river is lovely at this time of night, don't you think?

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: Please be respectful here - these are the bones of our ancestors.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: < Waking Cloud Ghost of She Bark >
EN: So this is the Ghost of She's lair. I was never brave enough to try to find it....

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: Civilization isn't perfect, but neither is tribal life. You should go see it for yourself.
EN: Really? You think so? Hoo! I'm going to do it. After all this is over, I'm going to go explore civilization!

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: Civilization isn't perfect, but neither is tribal life. You should go see it for yourself.
EN: {Thank you, my friend}Dank ni, ahk iss - I never would have had the {guts}growans to ask him myself.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: You should stay here with your people. You have a duty to them.
EN: I see. Well, thanks for your telling. I'd like a minute alone to think about this. {Thanks}Dank ni.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: He said he has a hard time being objective about the whole idea, and that I should give you advice.
EN: He said that? Well, I guess you have been out there more recently than he has. So... what's your advice?

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: {Nervous}We should not be here! The Three Marys is where the White Legs make their camp! We should leave, quickly.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: I am always a little sad to leave the Narrows, and happy to return.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: It has been some time since I visited the Dead Horses. Our tribes don't have much contact with each other.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: This is Pine Creek, one of the only ways out of Zion Valley. Watch out - many dangerous beasts lair nearby.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
EN: These are places of the time before. We should not be here - it is forbidden!

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: Tell me about the Ghost of She.
EN: That is a sad story. I do not like to tell it, but if you are asking, it must be at White Bird's request. That, I will honor.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: Tell me about the Ghost of She.
EN: Long ago, a girl lived among this tribe. She was a curious child, and a clever one, and her mother had a devil's time watching over her.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: Tell me about the Ghost of She.
EN: One day, the child slipped away from camp and went to play in the caves nearby. The girl did not know that a Yao Guai slept in that cave.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: Tell me about the Ghost of She.
EN: The girl died. The tribe wept, for the girl had died before her naming day, and her ghost would remain restless and wandering upon the earth.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: Tell me about the Ghost of She.
EN: Many hunters tried to kill the beast, but it eluded them, or drove them off. The shaman said that since it had consumed the girl, the two were one.

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: Tell me about the Ghost of She.
EN: So we call the beast Ghost of She, for the child had no name to be called. That is the story of the Ghost of She. It is a sad story. It is our story.

Speaker: White Bird
Topic_Name: Who or what is the Ghost of She?
EN: Sad story. Not for your ears from my lips. Ask midwife. She speak to your ears.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: Feels good to be doing some actual scouting, not just following.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: I hear some odd things about the civilized lands outside Zion. Is there really a giant thunder-lizard people live inside?

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: The spitter plants and the green monster men aren't native to Zion. Wonder where they came from?

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: So I finally get to explore all those taboo places without the other scouts yelling at me? Can't wait!

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
ActorNotes: [Talking himself/his home up; wants to impress the player]
EN: {Talking himself/his home up; wants to impress the player}Bet they don't have anything as nasty as Yao Guai out where you come from, huh?

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: Those, um, what did you call them? {Maybe mispronounce a little}Walkie talkies? Those are going to be loads better than signal drums and smoke signs.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: That compass thing always knows where north is, huh? Even if it can't see the stars?

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: That Back When medicine smells funny. Guess it works though.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: There can't really be a place where people go into big buildings and give away all their money just to watch someone flip paper squares on a table...

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: Way I heard it, Salt-Upon-Wounds butchered everyone in New Canaan and nailed their corpses to the cliffs.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: Why do you carry all those bottlecaps, anyway? They jangle like crazy.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: Look sharp, lots of giant ants around here. We call 'em picnic-killers. Don't really know what that means. Something from Back When, I guess.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: Must have been nice, when Zion was friendly enough folks could make camp wherever they pleased and not worry about White Legs and deadly critters.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: "Scenic Overlook." What do you suppose that means?

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: See that tower? Back When, folks used them to talk to each other on the air. Not like with signal drums, they could actually talk! Amazing, huh?

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: See this? This is why your own two feet are better than any cart, whether it's pulled by critters or goes on its own.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: That thing actually flew once, like a big metal bird? {Wistful}Bet you don't have to follow chalk marks up there....

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: You ever seen anything like these green men? Sure as anything they aren't from around here.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: Some kind of view up here, neh? If you know how to look, you can spot all kinds of landmarks from up here. Look, I'll show you.

Speaker: Dead Horse Disciple of Canaan
EN: Hoi! {Outsider seek Joshua Graham?}{AUS-land-er ZOOK-uh Joshua Graham?}Owslandr zookuh Joshua Graham?

Speaker: Dead Horse Disciple of Canaan
EN: Show respect, {AUS-land-er}owslandr! Joshua Graham greatest warchief!

Speaker: Dead Horse Disciple of Canaan
Topic_Name: Am I... looking for Joshua? Yes, I am. Can you tell me where he is?
EN: {Somewhat pleased}You know our tongue - smart {AUS-land-er}owslandr.

Speaker: Dead Horse Disciple of Canaan
Topic_Name: Am I... looking for Joshua? Yes, I am. Can you tell me where he is?
EN: Joshua in high place of cave. You show respect, utman! Joshua is greatest warrior. You show him no respect, he show you thunder and fire!

Speaker: Dead Horse Disciple of Canaan
Topic_Name: Yes, I'm looking for him. Is he here?
EN: He in high place of cave. You show respect, {AUS-land-er}owslandr! Joshua is greatest warrior. You show him no respect, he show you thunder and fire!

Speaker: Dead Horse Disciple of Canaan
Topic_Name: I'll make sure to be on my best behavior, then.
EN: You wise for {AUS-land-er}owslandr.

Speaker: Dead Horse Disciple of Canaan
Topic_Name: Umm... okay. Thanks for that. I sure would hate to be shown thunder and fire.
EN: {Not amused at all}Ha ha. Funny {AUS-land-er}owslandr. Maybe soon dead owslandr.

Speaker: Dead Horse Disciple of Canaan
Topic_Name: Back off, savage - I'm just here for a map out of this shithole valley, not kowtow to your messiah.
EN: {"Shit!"}Shaiss! Would kill you myself, but Joshua says no harm to visitors until harm done to us.

Speaker: Dead Horse Disciple of Canaan
Topic_Name: Back off, savage - I'm just here for a map out of this shithole valley, not kowtow to your messiah.
EN: Go, {AUS-land-er}owslandr. Meet Joshua. We see how long you talk like that.

Speaker: Ricky
Topic_Name: Vow of secrecy? Fine, forget about it.
EN: Forget it? Uh uh. Ricky remembers everything! But he keeps his secrets, too!

Speaker: Waking Cloud
Topic_Name: What do you know about Salt-Upon-Wounds?
EN: He is war chief of the White Legs, and the worst butcher of them all. The tribes he has crushed are many. The warriors he has slain, countless.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: Here we are. Joshua's just ahead there, in the Angel Cave.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: Nearly there now. Watch out for traps in the water. Got to keep the White Legs out somehow, neh?

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: Hang on, you're going the wrong way!

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: I thought we were going to the Dead Horses camp?

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: Hold up, you're getting all turned around. Check your map and backtrack a little.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: Where are you going? That's not the way to the camp!

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: I'm happy to travel with you, but you're not headed toward the Dead Horses anymore.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: Down this path to the north. Hope you don't mind getting wet.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: You see the dead sentries? Shamans say our enemies' souls are trapped in them, but Joshua says it shows we're serious about fighting White Legs.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: Follow the old road south, nearly there.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: Keep headed north, around this rock pile.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: You can take the path north here if you want, or head east over the ridge. There's a nice view from the top of that cliff, if you want a look.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: We follow this path for a while. Nice view of the river, neh?

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: I have some gear that needs repairs.
EN: Let me have a look. My tribe may take too much pride in its mechanical talents, but in truth we are intrigued by the workings of a fine firearm.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: I have some gear that needs repairs.
EN: Let me have a look.

Speaker: Dead Horse Disciple of Canaan
Topic_Name: I'm sorry, I don't understand you.
EN: {Repeating himself; "Outsider seeks Joshua Graham?"}{AUS-land-er ZOOK-uh Joshua Graham?}Owslandr utman zookuh Joshua Graham? {Searching for english words}You look for Joshua Graham?

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: Huh, I think I know that guy. Small world.
EN: Is it? I always heard it was rather large outside the valley. Well, wherever he is, I hope he's well.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: I know that guy! I got him a job!
EN: A job as a singer? {Full of wonder; just got told Santa Claus is real}Then it really is true....

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: Any idea where to start looking for these pre-War supplies Daniel needs?
EN: Best place to look for Back When stuff is the taboo places. Sorrows and Dead Horses don't go in there, and even White Legs don't like them much.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: Lots of them around the valley - places built by the folk from Back When. You'll know them when you see them - scouts mark them with hand prints.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: The hand prints are a warning to keep out - angry ghosts live inside. Not that I believe in angry ghosts. They're just spooky old places. Right?

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: Lots of Back When places to choose from, but for the things we need, best to start with the really closed up places.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: Three I know of: a building down by the river called a "Fishing Lodge," the old ranger station in the northwest, and the general store right by it.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: Closer to home, might be something you can salvage from the place where the little ones fell, just west of the Eastern Virgin.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: What's this "place where the little ones fell?"
EN: In the river, there's a twisted pile of metal and glass, all full of bones. Joshua says they were scouts, but they looked awful small to me.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: What's this "place where the little ones fell?"
EN: Lots of that old stuff, how do you say it... {stilted, forced pronunciation}electronics? Maybe you could use some of it.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: White Legs? Those are the people who attacked us?
EN: Yah, and they're still back there! Let's go get them!

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: If you're willing, I'll take the help.
EN: {Glad to hear it}Goot sists. Let's show them what we're made of!

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: Forget it, I'm out of here.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: Hoo! That's for the White Legs! Sorry we weren't fast enough to save your friends, though. The Dead Horses will remember them in our prayers.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: You should come with me now - Joshua Graham will want to meet a visitor from the civilized lands.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: {Hushed, tense, big scary monster ahead!}Freeze! Don't move a muscle. Yao Guai.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: Hoo! That was some kind of lucky. Guess that one was all full of gecko, neh? Don't get used to it, though. Yao Guai are plenty mean as a rule.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: What do you know of Salt-Upon-Wounds?
EN: He's a butcher. Believe me, I know the godless fire that burns in his heart. I've been burned by it myself.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: What do you know of Salt-Upon-Wounds?
EN: He's not the kind to let his subordinates do all the killing. No, he likes to have a hand in it, with that spear of his.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: What do you know of Salt-Upon-Wounds?
EN: He's fashioned himself an abomination before the eyes of the Lord. I'm happy to serve as an instrument of divine justice.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: What do you know of the White Legs?
EN: They're hateful savages who live only to plunder and destroy. Their leader is a devil called Salt-Upon-Wounds.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: What do you know of the White Legs?
EN: War is what all he knows. Everything he has, everything that tribe has, was taken by force, raiding and scavenging.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: What do you know of the White Legs?
EN: It's said there's no man deadlier at close range, that that powerfist of his has smashed a hundred skulls.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: What do you know of the White Legs?
EN: Maybe that's true, but so what? It's a low form of leadership. A tribe that knows only war has no future. And so he'll lead them to Caesar.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: Here, take five of my healing powders.
EN: That's very generous of you. Five doses will help a great deal.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: Here, take three of my healing powders.
EN: Thanks. That will help a good deal.

Speaker: Joshua Graham
Topic_Name: How do you know so much about what happened to me?
EN: The Dead Horses are capable scouts. Nothing passes into or out of Zion without my hearing of it.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: See those handprints? Dead Horses and Sorrows mark them on taboo places, places from Back When. Good thing for you I don't buy into that stuff.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: These paintings show the Dead Horses' victories against other tribes. Lots more of them since Joshua came to us.

Speaker: Stella
EN: {anxious}Ain't the trail ahead worries me, Jed. Those descents we made, through that slot canyon back up there?

Speaker: Stella
EN: Ain't no way we're getting back out the way we come. And then what?

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {exasperated}Goddammit, Stella, heard you the first time, and the fifteenth, too.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: The New Canaanites will know a way. And if they don't, we got the maps on our friend's Pip-Boy over there.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {raising voice, giving orders}Enough lollygagging! Get moving and keep an eye out for tribals!

Speaker: Ricky
EN: {sneering}Yeah, whatever.

Speaker: Stella
EN: Catch you another time, then.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration}Probably just a tribal ghost story. But New Canaan's been silent for a long time. Maybe it's a coincidence. Maybe the Malpais Legate is dead.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration}Or maybe Joshua Graham did crawl out of that canyon and finally found his way back home.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration}He got his wish. Joshua Graham disappeared. And in his place came legends of the Burned Man walking the wastes.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration}All this talk bothered Caesar, so he forbade anyone from speaking his name. Wanted to erase Joshua Graham from history.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration}Not long after, some of the slaves and tribals started to talk. Said Graham wasn't dead. Shouldn't have been any surprise.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration}He had Graham covered in pitch, lit on fire, and thrown into the Grand Canyon. People say he didn't even scream on the way down.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration}Caesar had to make an example for the others, to show them that even at the highest level, failure wouldn't be tolerated.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration}Well at Hoover Dam, the Malpais Legate finally met his match. Hanlon and Oliver kicked his New Canaanite butt right back over the river.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration}Legend goes that Graham was the meanest, toughest son of a bitch in the whole damned Legion.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration}The New Canaanites wouldn't talk about him. They were ashamed. Guess I can't blame 'em.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration}Turns out Caesar's first war chief, the Malpais Legate, was a New Canaanite. Joshua Graham.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration}But then the Legion appeared in Arizona. I reckon you know all about them.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration}We've seen our share of cults, but the New Canaanites, they were honest traders. Good fighters, too. Raiders wouldn't tangle with 'em.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration}Didn't know much about them, except that they were religious folks. Sent out missionaries to talk to the tribes.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration}A few decades back, folks in the NCR started to hear about a community in northern Utah called New Canaan.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: {Narration}The paths we're following are slow going, so you might as well keep your ears open and listen to what old Jed has to say.

EN: You ain't never been to Zion, have you? We'll be passing through a whole mess of narrow slot canyons and high, rough passes.

EN: A big pack'll get you wedged in like a Super Mutant crawling through a storm drain, and too much weight will kill you in the thin air.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
Topic_Name: Actually, let me take care of some more things first.
EN: Fair enough. Come on back when you're ready.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: Well, all right then. Let's get moving. We've got a long road ahead of us...

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: Hang on - ain't you the one that wiped out the Crimson Caravan's Vegas branch not too long ago?

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: Ought to thank you for that - knocking McLafferty out of the running gives Happy Trails a market to expand into.

Speaker: Jed Masterson

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: You sure you want to be here? McLafferty's non-competes are pretty rigid.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: Damn good thing you came along, too. We had another prospect with a Pip-Boy, but he done skedaddled. Something must've spooked the boy.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: Our advance scouts leave chalk signs to mark places rich with game. I'm not a full scout yet, so I follow the marks and guide the hunters.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: I don't have any more questions. Let's talk about something else.
EN: Ask away.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: I want to know more about you.
EN: What can I tell you?

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: Shoot.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: Dangerous enough we won't be going near them if we can help it. I got no desire for my head to decorate some little gas station fort's walls, thanks.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: That's right. The folks that lived in Zion before the war, they didn't just get a little savage, they're downright feral.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: Most of them don't even speak English any more - you got to get yourself a New Canaanite translator to talk to them.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: The ones you really got to watch out for are the White Legs, from the Great Salt Lake. They'll attack just about anyone that ain't one of theirs.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: They're about what you'd expect - crazy, jacked up on chems, violent as hell, and not too bright.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: The worst are the {eighties}80s, but we won't be passing through their turf on this run.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
Topic_Name: You don't know what happened to their mission?
EN: Nope - hence this caravan. If we don't make contact with the New Canaanites, Happy Trails might as well just shrivel up and die.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
Topic_Name: Do you know anything about their religion?
EN: I ain't a prayin' man myself. They paid for their goods and dealt square with us, that's all I ever cared about.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
Topic_Name: Do you know anything about their religion?
EN: But don't think that just because they're religious that they're pacifists. They take care of their own, and they're damn fine marksmen too.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: [SUCCEEDED] You ain't wrong. Losing the Salt Lake City run really stung us. If we can't re-establish contact with this run, we'll be in real trouble.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: It sounds like Happy Trails isn't in the best financial shape.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: [FAILED] We do all right, don't you worry about us. Got enough in the kitty to pay you, anyways.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: So, you guys are totally rich, right?

Speaker: Jed Masterson
Topic_Name: Why can't you get to Salt Lake City?
EN: Without New Canaan's mission in Zion, the only ways to Salt Lake City are down the old I-80 or up through Ogden.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
Topic_Name: Why can't you get to Salt Lake City?
EN: The highway's too risky - NCR's rangers are so busy here in the Mojave they don't have the manpower to keep the raiders off.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
Topic_Name: Why can't you get to Salt Lake City?
EN: Ogden's just too far - we'd lose more in travel expenses than we'd ever earn.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
Topic_Name: All right, I'll come back when I'm carrying less than 75 pounds.
EN: There's a chest over yonder, you can store your extra in that. It'll be safe as can be until you get back.

EN: There's a chest over yonder, you can store your extra in that. It'll be safe as can be until you get back.

Topic_Name: All right, I'll come back when I'm carrying less than 75 pounds.
EN: All right, I'll come back when I'm carrying less than 100 pounds.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
Topic_Name: Who is Joshua Graham, and why shouldn't I talk about him?
EN: Just don't. It makes the New Canaanites powerful uncomfortable, and it scares the britches off the tribals.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
Topic_Name: Who is Joshua Graham, and why shouldn't I talk about him?
EN: Don't talk about the Burned Man either, while you're at it. Trust me on this one, it's for your own good.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
Topic_Name: Tell me more about the job.
EN: The job is simple - help us get this caravan into Zion and find New Canaan. The pay is 25 caps per day, half up front, half on return.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
Topic_Name: Tell me more about the job.
EN: You'll get a bonus if we make it into Zion, plus another bonus if we reach New Canaan.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
Topic_Name: Tell me more about the job.
EN: Oh, one more thing - don't mention the name Joshua Graham to anyone. {Repeat for emphasis}Anyone.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
Topic_Name: How about a game of Caravan to kill some time?

Speaker: Jed Masterson
Topic_Name: How about a game of Caravan to kill some time?

Speaker: Jed Masterson
Topic_Name: I haven't been through Utah recently - what's the situation like?
EN: You got raiders all over the damn place, tribes of degenerates that'll eat you as soon as look at you, regional warlords... the works.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
Topic_Name: I haven't been through Utah recently - what's the situation like?
EN: Not too many decent places to stop and trade. New Canaan's one of the only ones left I know about.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
Topic_Name: I understand this caravan is headed to Zion. What can you tell me about the area?
EN: Well, I ain't never been inside, myself. Did some trading with the New Canaanites from their mission there, but that was all on the outskirts.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
Topic_Name: I understand this caravan is headed to Zion. What can you tell me about the area?
EN: All the old ways in and out were destroyed after the War, but we got ourselves the location of a pass the New Canaanites use - that's our way in.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
Topic_Name: I understand this caravan is headed to Zion. What can you tell me about the area?
EN: That's why I wanted someone with a Pip-Boy on the caravan - the map'll be helpful for checking the topography, keeping us on the trail.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about New Canaan?
EN: Don't know much about the place, but I can tell you about the people. The New Canaanites were some kind of religious group from before the War.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about New Canaan?
EN: They control the old city of Ogden, a ways north of Zion, and they got themselves a nice defensible mission in the canyon itself - or they did.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about New Canaan?
EN: They trade a fair bit with the tribes in Zion - well, the ones that don't try and kill them, anyways.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
Topic_Name: Tell me about Happy Trails Caravan Company.
EN: We're a smaller company out of Sac-Town, up in the northern part of the NCR. We run some business through New Reno, there on the "Little Loop."

Speaker: Jed Masterson
Topic_Name: Tell me about Happy Trails Caravan Company.
EN: Had a nice run to Salt Lake City, too - but then we lost contact with New Canaan, and that went all to hell.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: Heh. All right, I'll believe you - Lord knows I ain't going to pat you down to find out for myself.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Don't worry about me. I'm used to finding out-of-the-way places to stuff my gear.

Speaker: Jed Masterson
EN: Heh. I do believe you could.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Not only could I carry my own gear, I could carry yours, his, and one of your brahmins'.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk

EN: He's been the chief of our tribe since he came back to the Valley. He went off to the civilized world years ago, to fight a war. That didn't go well.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: Why do you need a map of Grand Staircase?
EN: Grand Staircase is farther east, deeper into the Colorado Plateau.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: Why do you need a map of Grand Staircase?

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: Why do you need a map of Grand Staircase?
EN: Throughout our history, we have called many places Zion. This valley is full of God's beauty, but it's just a place. Zion is more than this.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: Why do you need a map of Grand Staircase?
EN: We cannot use any and all means available just to protect stone and water and a piece of sky. We have to hold on to our faith. Far more enduring.

Speaker: Daniel
Topic_Name: Why do you need a map of Grand Staircase?
EN: If we sacrifice grace for a piece of land, we may live in this valley, but we will no longer dwell in Zion. It's better for us to leave now.

Speaker: Daniel
EN: Your generosity is... {sighs, not sure what to say} well, I just can't thank you enough.

Speaker: Daniel
EN: Thanks. Even one dose can make a difference.

Topic_Name: Is there any other way I can help the Sorrows?

EN: {sighs, relieved}That's great news. We can use anything you can offer.

EN: Holy hell, it's the White Legs! What are they doing this far south?

Speaker: Salt-Upon-Wounds

Speaker: Salt-Upon-Wounds
Topic_Name: I've already crushed your warriors. Retreat now and rebuild your tribe, or die in obscurity.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk

Speaker: Follows-Chalk

Speaker: Follows-Chalk

Speaker: Follows-Chalk

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: When Joshua first came to us, he was servant to a man he called Caesar. He led his master's armies, and we were ready to follow him into war.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: Then he lost his master's army to a tribe called Enseeyar, the Sunset People. When he returned, he was as you saw him - burned, broken, but changed.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: He led us away from Caesar, led us to our own destiny in Zion.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk

EN: {Bewildered - doesn't really understand how this is a question, like "Why is it important to breathe?"}Well... because they're our enemies. What else would we do? They take our land, they kill our scouts, they poach our hunting grounds.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: What's with the shell casings in your club?
EN: We decorate our clubs with them to honor Joshua Graham. They were the weapons of his old tribe, so now they are ours.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: What's with the shell casings in your club?

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: What do you know about the New Canaanites?

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: Do you remember anything about Joshua from before he became your leader?

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: Do you remember anything about Joshua from before he became your leader?

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: What did Joshua do for you?

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
Topic_Name: What did Joshua do for you?

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: We came up in the Land of the Dead Horse, though why the Back When folks called it that I got no hint.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
EN: We raided, we fought... we lost. Our enemies drove us back into Zion, and we would have died if it hadn't been for Joshua. Joshua, and his Caesar.

Speaker: Follows-Chalk
